verdict.rationale: AWS Budgets is documented for tracking costs. It can alert on both actual and forecasted spend against a monthly budget, and budget actions can automatically apply an IAM policy that blocks further provisioning. The Free plan claims 'no surprise bills', which supports day-one cost control. However, the story explicitly asks for documented anomaly detection on spend, and the pack contains no evidence of an anomaly-detection capability; forecasted budget alerts are not the same thing. Missing for 10: documented spend anomaly detection, independent or hands-on corroboration that budget alerts and actions work as described.
